questions.q: Which address is mentioned in the video?
questions.e: In the video: "Topolska 18 na Vračaru" — one of the best-known Belgrade addresses.

questions.q: Which family was housed at this address in the series "Ljubav, navika, panika"?
questions.e: In the video: "komične avanture porodice Milićević" — the comic adventures of the Milićević family.

o: Divorced parents living under one roof
questions.e: In the video: "razvedeni roditelji Vera i Mića nastavili su da žive pod istim krovom" — the divorced parents Vera and Mića continued to live under the same roof.

questions.q: What was the younger daughter Janja up to?
o: Looking for ways to profit from the family madness
questions.e: In the video: "mlađa Janja pronalazila načine da izvuče korist iz porodičnog ludila" — the younger Janja found ways to profit from the family madness.

questions.q: What do the series "Srećni ljudi" and "Ljubav, navika, panika" have in common?
questions.e: In the video: "spajajući tako dva izuzetno popularna projekta na jednoj istoj adresi" — thus joining two extremely popular projects at one and the same address.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Razvedeni — divorced; razvesti se — to get divorced.
Krov — roof. Pod istim krovom — under one roof.
Svađa — a quarrel; pun svađa — full of quarrels.
Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na Vračaru.

questions.q: Nastavili su da žive pod istim ___.
questions.e: Pod in answer to "where?" requires the instrumental case: pod krovom.

questions.q: Ova lokacija ostala je najpre ___ po čuvenom hitu iz serije
questions.e: The participle agrees with the subject: lokacija is feminine singular, so upamćena.

questions.q: koja u ___ kulturi nosi poseban status.
questions.e: U + locative. Kultura is feminine: u domaćoj kulturi.
